subject: CloudCart marketplace: invoice traceability & audit evidence plan
body:
---Message 1 (original)---
From: Allyson Hue <allyson.hue@cloudcart.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudcart.com
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: invoice trail + audit evidence for marketplace revenue pass-through

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call today. To move the reseller onboarding forward for CloudCart, finance needs:

- A sample invoice trail showing marketplace pass-through flow (seller -> marketplace -> reseller settlement)
- The draft Order Form (redlines) that reflect pass-through language and indemnity carveouts
- A contact at Redwood who can own evidence gathering for a potential audit (SOC / invoice audit)

Can you send a pack with the sample CSV and a timeline for when legal can review the Order Form? Procurement would like to close this week if possible.

Appreciate it,
Allyson
Allyson Hue
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudCart

---Message 2 (reply)---
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Allyson Hue <allyson.hue@cloudcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: invoice trail + audit evidence for marketplace revenue pass-through

Allyson —

Thanks — we can absolutely pull together an evidence pack. Quick notes and next steps from our side: 

1) Evidence pack: we will provide a redacted invoice trail CSV (sample attached) + a one-page mapping that explains where fees and pass-through amounts appear on our statements.
2) Order Form redlines: Marissa (legal) will prepare targeted redlines showing proposed language for pass-through, seller liability allocation, and an audit access clause. We will keep indemnity narrow.
3) Audit ownership: I will be the internal owner and will coordinate evidence requests; Karthik (Partner Ops) will run a reconciliation to ensure the sample matches our settlement exports.

Requested timing:
- Draft redlines to you by EOD 2027-05-21
- Sample invoice trail (redacted) by 2027-05-21 morning
- Final evidence pack and upload to shared Drive by 2027-05-22

If procurement needs a quicker signal to proceed, we can provide an interim confirmation letter indicating Redwood accepts the proposed pass-through mechanics subject to final Order Form sign-off.

Action for Marissa: add the narrow audit access clause (see bullets below) and push redlines back to Allyson.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

---Message 3 (internal)---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-21T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Draft Order Form redlines + proposed audit clause

Irene / Karthik —

Attached is Draft_OrderForm_Redlines_20270521.docx with tracked changes. Highlights: 
- Pass-through fee language: explicit mapping of Marketplace Fees and Reseller Settlement amounts; added defined term "Marketplace Fee" to avoid ambiguity.
- Liability carveouts: limited Redwood liability to direct fees collected; removed broad reseller indemnity where it would overlap with seller obligations.
- Audit clause (proposed):
  * Redwood will provide, within 10 business days of a written request, redacted transaction-level settlement reports and summaries necessary to validate fee allocation for the covered period.
  * Audit obligations limited to one audit per 12-month period per customer, conducted by an independent third party, with Redwood allowed to redact customer-specific PII.
  * Any additional evidence requests that require engineering effort (e.g., raw event logs) will be scoped and billed under a separate SOW.

Please review the attached and confirm whether we should send this to Allyson with the sample invoice CSV.

Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---Message 4 (external)---
From: Allyson Hue <allyson.hue@cloudcart.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudcart.com
Date: 2027-05-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: invoice trail + audit evidence for marketplace revenue pass-through

Irene / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. Procurement reviewed the draft and the audit clause looks reasonable. Attached is a sample invoice trail (InvoiceTrail_Sample_20270522.csv) we prepared illustrating how CloudCart shows the marketplace fee and seller payout. This should help you align the mapping doc.

Two asks from our side before we route to legal sign-off: 
1) Can you confirm whether the redacted settlement reports will include internal invoice IDs so we can reconcile?
2) Please confirm the proposed 10 business day turnaround — procurement needs that guarantee in writing for our audit schedule.

We also uploaded a pre-signed DocuSign envelope with the initial Order Form (link below) so we can expedite once redlines are agreed.

Link: https://www.docusign.com/link/1234-CloudCart-OrderForm
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HC-4721
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-CloudCart-Evidence

If you can confirm both items today, procurement will set a tentative signature window for Friday.

Best,
Allyson
---

Attachments referenced in thread: CloudCart_Audit_Request_20270519.pdf; Draft_OrderForm_Redlines_20270521.docx; InvoiceTrail_Sample_20270522.csv

Summary of action items:
- Marissa: finalize redline language around audit evidence and liability carveouts (due EOD 2027-05-21) [done, sent 2027-05-21 09:48]
- Irene: confirm sample mapping and internal invoice ID inclusion (reply pending)
- Karthik: run reconciliation and validate CSV mapping (deliverable 2027-05-21)
- All: confirm 10 business day SLA for evidence delivery in writing (requested by CloudCart today)
